_readme: Yugo Austin Waterloo. Existing footprint, floor heights and open south crown retained. +u east, +v north. Paired opaque-panel/glazing modules, recessed blade slots and polygon channel lettering reconstructed from exterior references. Proportions and night appearance are estimates, not surveyed dimensions. Fine lettering and masonry relief use the existing sign detail cutoff 0.6; primary facades keep the shared stable-window filtering path.
name: Yugo Austin Waterloo

sources.satellite: Esri World Imagery z20: the tower roof covers the whole site (mechanical, pool deck at the south end) - no separate lower podium wing
sources.facts: 30 storeys, ~95 m to the main roof (DCI Engineers: 300 ft); BOKA Powell + Hip Hop Studio; 2022
sources.geometry: Local exterior reference review; original surveyed footprint unchanged. Opaque/glazed bay pattern, three punched podium rows over a two-level glazed base, recessed slot blade and upper glazed corner.

lobby._src: a double-height black-framed glass storefront (podium photos 05-07)

podium._src: near-black brick; every opening in a raised brick frame; portrait glass windows alternating with white glazed-brick panels of the same size (05, straight on)

east._src: Light precast frame with paired blue glazing and pale opaque infill.

crown._src: Glazed enclosed northern amenity volume. The south end is a lower open terrace, not a second enclosed glazed floor.

lobbyUpper._src: a double-height black-framed glass storefront (podium photos 05-07)

blocks._src: Three punched masonry rows above two glazed base levels, with deep paired openings and light glazed-brick infill.
Existing footprint and floor grid retained. The south-west glazed corner turns onto the south elevation; the remaining south face has punched windows, not a full-width curtain wall.

signs._note: Continuous font-contour rims, 0.11 m face width; clean mitred joins replace self-intersecting widened paths.

blocks._src: Five recessed narrow slot columns; double-height top slots below raised outlined channel lettering.
one silver mechanical enclosure at the north-west corner of the roof (notes.md)
Enclosed two-storey northern crown, with lower open terrace to the south. Split position is an approximate exterior-photo proportion, not a surveyed dimension.
The lower south terrace is open to the sky over the residential facade, with the glazed corner continuing below its guardrail.
Lower dark screen in front of the retained taller north roof enclosure; approximate proportions from exterior crown views.

deck._src: Open-to-sky south terrace with a two-panel-high tinted glass windscreen. Height 2.05 m and rail spacing are appearance estimates from exterior views. Glass uses the existing reflective material proxy. No neighboring rooftop court or pool has been copied.

night.note: Sparse mixed residential rooms, unlit blade recesses, subdued crown glazing and warm outlined lettering. Visual occupancy is an appearance setting.
night.fixtureNote: Approximate amenity downlights on the authored roof/terrace. Position and falloff are appearance estimates; not surveyed fixture locations.
